title: May 2026 five-destination LNG hypothetical FOB gross-value scenarios
calculation: gross value in USD millions = Bcf × assumed MMBtu/Mcf × FOB USD/MMBtu
explanation: 1 Bcf equals 1 million Mcf; multiplying Bcf by MMBtu/Mcf yields million MMBtu. The 1.037 reference is an illustrative conversion assumption, not measured shipment-specific heating value.
coverage: Only five reported destinations; excludes other US LNG destinations and does not represent total US LNG exports
limitations: Scenario gross FOB values only, not actual realized company cash receipts, operating profits, tax revenue or national economic benefit
No cargo-specific higher heating values, contractual pricing or reconciliation of timing and invoices
DOE destination average FOB prices may not be volume-weighted for exactly the reported shipments
No costs for feedgas, liquefaction, pipeline transport, shipping, capital, financing, taxes or domestic price effects included
Do not use for country influence scores, economic gain attribution or net US benefit
